d:
These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, friend. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.
I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.
I must study their brains!
Retrieve ten of their brains for me, friend. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.
highelf-female
p: Have you returned with the requested organs?
c:
This is wondrous, friend! My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.
Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... For a price.

d:
Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done!
Oh yes, the price remains the same, friend. Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.
highelf-female
p: Have you returned with the requested organs?
c:
Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, friend.
Take it... And friend, do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. The results could be disastrous.

d:
Death does indeed have wings in these blasted lands, traveler. I have witnessed the black slayers and bonepickers feasting upon the corpse of many a fallen explorer - sometimes feeding upon the most vile and disease ridden of carcasses. It is a wonder, then, how their internal systems overcome the pestilence that claims these lands.
Assist me in my studies, friend! Gizzards I need! Two snickerfang jowls will also be required for the base of the concoction.
You shall be rewarded two-fold for your efforts.
highelf-female
p: Do not waste my time, friend. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
c:
Most excellent! I shall get to work immediately. Perhaps a cure for many of the ailments of the world is to be found!
Ah yes, your reward - of course, should you require more of the gum, return to me and another task you shall be given.

d:
I see that the inner fire has dwindled. Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour?
If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. Back to the wastelands, friend. Do not return until you have recovered ten gizzards and two jowls.
highelf-female
p: Do not waste my time, friend. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
c: Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.

d:
I've got an idea, see. I've heard of some strange creatures called dew collectors that live to the southwest... And that they are able to store water in special glands.
I think that if I could get one of these glands, I could create a drink that would quench my terrible thirst! Do you think you could help me, friend?
Look for the cactus garden, friend; that's where you'll find the dew collectors.
goblin-male
p: Please, tell me you found the dew collectors?
c: Oh, wonderful! Give it here -- let me drink it!

d:
Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...
Wait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.
Uhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.
I mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...
goblin-male
p: So old Marin's up to it again, eh? What's this concoction made from?
c:
Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... Eccentric, I'd say.
And of course he needs my help, yet again.

d:
It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, friend.
A cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
human-male
c: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.

d:
Oh my, you look like death. Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. You, sir, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.
Hah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!
Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... Fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, friend.
gnome-male

It's unanimous, friend. You've got the 'itis.'
Luckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'
Here's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse silk thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.
Hurry along now, friend, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.
gnome-male
p: If you want the 'itis' cured, you're going to have to try harder than that, friend. Where are the reagents for the cure?
c:
What am I doing? What does it look like I'm doing? I'm devising a cure for your 'itis!' Don't get indignant with me now, friend!
Just a few more seconds. There! Just spray this, um, fantastic smelling medicine on yourself and you'll be as good as new.

d:
Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.
So here I stand, awaiting orders. I must know. I must have those orders.
Dispatch Commander Ruag resides in Stonard. Find him and find out what became of the orders.
orc-male
c:
Thrall's Grasp... The story is still fresh in my mind.
Terrible thing that happened to that regiment. The horde lost some of its best soldiers when that battalion was destroyed.

d:
The orders? What could you possibly want with the orders?
What are you implying, friend? Of course I relayed those orders! The soldiers I sent the orders with were ambushed and brutally beaten by murlocs. Only one survived, if you can call that surviving. He can hardly speak, cannot walk, and must be fed through a tube. If you want to know what happened to those orders, speak with Bengor. I'm sure he is around here somewhere... And, friend, be mindful of what you stick your nose into - it may get bitten off.
orc-male

Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... Took orders. On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.
Murlocs... Many murlocs... One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. East... Cave....
orc-male
c:
It is worse than I imagined. Nineteen of my men could have been spared from the agony which they faced. If only I had not acted so irrationally.
You must help them, friend! I am powerless to act.

d:
When I was a kid, my sister used to do all the cooking. It was horrible! I could barely stomach some of her concoctions -- until I found what I like to call my "secret" ingredient! Add it to anything, and... WOW! It tastes great!
What is it, you ask? It's a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. If you want me to help you turn this horrid-tasting brew into something edible, head to the Hinterlands, and look for a small lake there.
Oh, and remember, the Violet Tragan can only be found underwater.
goblin-female
p: Under the waters of that lake -- it's the only place where the Violet Tragan can be found. Hope you're good at holding your breath!
c:
That's the stuff, friend!
It looks so good, I might just... Haha, gotcha!

d: Here's the Violet Powder, friend. Take it to Marin and tell him he owes me a favor!
goblin-female
p: Oh, friend, you're finally back. What have you brought?
c: Violet Powder, eh? Let's give it a try -- it sure couldn't make it any worse, that's for sure!

d:
Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.
Come back and talk to me in a minute... After I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!
goblin-male
c:
Drink this! It's absolutely wonderful!!!
I knew I had it in me... Oh thanks again, friend for your help, but please, stand a little to the side, will you? You're blocking my business! I'm going to make millions on the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir, millions!
What's that? Sprinkle says I owe her a favor? Oh, that Sprinkle, such a kidder!

d:
It will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.
Gather a suitable group of adventurers and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.
Fight hard and die with honor, friend.
orc-male
p: It is no easy task, friend. Do not give up!
c:
You have done it, friend! The poor, tortured souls can finally rest.
Our work is not yet over, friend. We have much to discuss and much more to accomplish.
